newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says in talks to sell enamel business.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says in talks to sell enamel business.

text.p: Bayer AG said on Thursday it was in advanced talks to sell its global enamel and ceramics business to British investment group Advent International and Chase Capital Partners.
Bayer, the German chemicals and pharmaceuticals group, said the enamel and ceramics business would be operated as an independent group and would be led by current management.
Bayer said it was awaiting regulatory approval for the planned sale.
"We are convinced that we have found an excellent partner with competence who is also prepared to provide further investment for growth," Bayer said in a statement.

Bayer said its ceramics business, which produces bathroom and household items along with ceramic tiles, had 1996 sales of about 200 million marks and has about 400 employees at locations around Europe and the United States.
